visualCharacteristics: Two side-by-side cards ("We want to hear from you" with Yes/No helpful prompt and a survey/contact card), followed by a last-updated and maintained-by attribution line; "Send feedback" opens an inline form.
contentPattern: Rows: feedback heading and copy, survey/contact text and links, last-updated date, maintainer.
usage: Page footer area of most DC.gov pages, just above the global footer.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on every page that ends with the feedback prompt; only the dates and maintainer change.
